theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmb_fcdr_cube_lipschitz
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (a : Euclid P), (∀ i, |a i - 1 / 2| < 1 / 4) → ∀ κ : (Fin P → ℝ) → ℝ, (∀ u v : Fin P → ℝ, ∀ t : ℝ, (∀ i, |u i - v i| ≤ t) → |κ u - κ v| ≤ t) → ∀ Φ : Euclid P → Euclid P, (∀ (y : Euclid P) (i : Fin P), Φ y i = a i + (y i - a i) / max (max ((y i - a i) / (1 - a i)) ((a i - y i) / a i)) (κ (fun j => max ((y j - a j) / (1 - a j)) ((a j - y j) / a j)))) → ∀ y y' : Euclid P, 0 < κ (fun j => max ((y j - a j) / (1 - a j)) ((a j - y j) / a j)) → dist (Φ y) (Φ y') ≤ 4 * Real.sqrt P / κ (fun j => max ((y j - a j) / (1 - a j)) ((a j - y j) / a j)) * dist y y'
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
